html:
Dear UCCians,

As we step into May, I’m thrilled to share with you some amazing achievements and events that we accomplished in the previous month.

Firstly, I want to give a big shoutout to all of our dedicated members who have put in an incredible amount of effort into our club rides. Together, we logged an astonishing 1,312 hours of cycling, covering a distance of 27,683 km and conquering an elevation of 1,64,302 meters. We had an incredible number of achievements last month with our members completing a record 64 centuries and 156 half-centuries. It’s inspiring to see the passion and hard work that our community puts into cycling.

Furthermore, I want to remind everyone of our upcoming longest ride, “Udaipur to Golden Temple,” which will take place in December. I’m thrilled to see so many members preparing themselves for this incredible journey.

Thank you for being an essential part of our cycling community, and I’m looking forward to seeing everyone’s continued hard work and dedication.

Happy cycling!

The Highlights of the Month

Udaipur Cycling Club is proud to announce some remarkable achievements by its members.

  • Dr Sharad Iyengar is our commute Rider of the Month. Dr. Sharad has demonstrated unwavering consistency in commuting to work on his bicycle, promoting personal health and reducing his carbon footprint. The club applauds his efforts and encourages others to adopt this eco-friendly commuting approach.
  • Rahul Jain, one of our esteemed members, has completed an incredible 25,000 kilometers in his cycling journey. Rahul has been a dedicated and passionate cyclist, and we are proud of his incredible achievement.
  • Jayant Nanawati’s achievement of covering 2500 km on his bicycle in April is a source of inspiration for the Udaipur Cycling Club. We congratulate him on his dedication and hope to see more people motivated to pursue their goals and enjoy cycling.
  • Hari Shankar Ji Kumawat completed his first-century ride at the age of 62, a remarkable achievement. His dedication and perseverance in reaching this milestone are truly inspiring for all cyclists, showing that age should never be a barrier to achieving your goals. Congratulations!
  • Ajith S, hailing from Kerala, completed his 100 KM ride with the Udaipur Cycling Club. We wish him continued success in his cycling journey.

April-2023 Club Statistics

Pedaling into Retirement – Conquered Maiden 100 KM

The Udaipur Cycling Club is a community that prides itself on inclusivity and support for members of all ages and backgrounds. That’s why we’re thrilled to introduce one of our members, Hari Shankar Ji Kumawat, who recently completed his first century (100 km cycling ride) at the age of 62 years.

Hari Shankar Ji Kumawat is a retired joint-commissioner who started cycling on May 15, 2022. Since then, he has covered an impressive distance of 2,535 km with an elevation of 14,292 meters. He has also completed 27 rides of 25 km and 19 rides of 50 km, which is a testament to his dedication to the sport.

Our Cyclist Poets

क्या कहती है मेरी साइकिल

ए मेरे दोस्त, मेरे साथी, मेरे रफ़ीक
चल उठ, चल उठ कही घूम कर आते है
चल उठ कही घूम कर आते है
निकल अपने पिंजरे से और सवेरे सवेरे बाहर की खूबसूरत रंगीन दुनिया देख कर आते है
खूबसूरत दुनिया जैसे उगता सूरज सुबह की पहली किरण पंछी की चेचाहट सुन कर आते है
चल मिल कर आते है तेरे दोस्तों से और जीवन की किताब में कुछ नये रंग बिखेर कर आते है
मत बन ग़ुलाम आपने ही पिंजरे का, मुझे नहीं बनना हिस्सा इस पिंजरे का
तुझे दोस्तों संग मुस्कुराते देख मुझे भी मज़ा आ गया
मानो जैसे दिन भर का Vitamin D (DOST) का कोटा पूरा हो गया
Nikhil Ranka | April 12, 2023


टेढ़े मेढ़े रास्ते

और देखिए रास्तों का अजब खेल ,
कुछ ख़्वाब से सुंदर,कुछ उबड़ ख़ाबड़,कुछ सरपट भागे,
थोड़ा रूठे हुए,कुछ मिलाते आपसे मेल ।
कुछ मंज़िलों तक ले जाते ,और कुछ नई राह दिखाते ।
थोड़े टेढ़े थोड़े मेढे ,कुछ जाने पहचाने और कुछ अनजाने ।फिर भी इन पर रोज़ आने का मन करता है कि आज कौन से नए सफ़र की कहानी लिखेंगे ।
और उसे यादों की गुल्लक में संजोए,किसी दिन फ़ुरसत में फिर उसे खोलेंगे।
और यह करने में जो चेहरे पर मुस्कान आती है,सुकून के उस पल के लिए शायद करते हैं हम ये करतब।
मोहल्ले के लोग अक्सर कहते हैं बस करो बहुत हुआ अब ।
अब उन्हें कौन समझाए कि रास्तों से ही हुई है दिल्लगी,
मंज़िल मिले न मिले ,जो चाहत थी वहाँ पहुँचे न पहुँचे,पर सफ़र दिलरुबा सा हसीन।
Akanksha Tripathi | April 19, 2023

कुछ तो खास है चाय में

ऐसे ही नहिं कहते चाय पे बात करते है,
चाय सिर्फ चाय नहीं,
चाय वक्त है दोस्तों संग मुस्कराने का,
चाय बहाना है पकौड़ो संग बारिश में प्यार जताने का,
चाय प्रयास है दूरियों को मिटाने का ,
चाय जोश है साइकिल चलाने का…
चाय एक रिवाज है थड़ी पे देवों को चढ़ाते का,
चाय जंहा बनतीं है एक दुनिया होती है वहां ,
मैने देखा है वहां हर छोटु को बड़ा होते हुए ,
कॉलेज स्टूडेंट्स को ख्वाब संजोते हुए,
देश और दुनिया की चर्चा अनजानों बीच होते हुए,
गाँव की पंचायत शहरों मैं चाय थड़ी पे होती है,
कम शक्कर ज्यादा शक्कर यहां सिर्फ मिठास की बात होती है,
कुछ तो बात है चाय मैं जो अमीर गरीब में फर्क नहीं करती .. प्याला बदल जाए पर चाय नहीं बदलति….
प्याला बदल जाए पर चाय नहीं बदलति….
Nitesh Tak, April 23, 2023

Meet Rahul Jain: The Man Who Aced 776 Rides and 25,000 km with UCC

We at Udaipur Cycling Club are proud to celebrate the achievement of our member, Rahul Jain, for completing a whopping 25,000 km with our club. This is a remarkable feat that deserves recognition, and we are thrilled to acknowledge his dedication and commitment to cycling.

Rahul joined our club in 2019, and since then, he has been a consistent and passionate rider. He started cycling as a hobby and has since made it a part of his daily routine. His friend and mentor, Sharad Jain, introduced him to cycling, and he hasn’t looked back since.

Not only is Rahul a skilled cyclist, but he is also a charming and handsome member of our club. He is also known for his love for tea, and we always enjoy sharing a cup of tea with him after our rides.

Rahul’s dedication to cycling is reflected in his impressive statistics. He has completed a total of 776 rides, covering a distance of 25,060 km, and climbing a total elevation of 87,768 m. He averages between 800 to 1000 km every month, and he enjoys long-distance rides with the group on Sundays.

We are thrilled to have Rahul as a member of our club, and we are grateful for his enthusiasm and commitment to cycling. We hope that he continues to inspire other members to achieve their cycling goals and reach new milestones. Congratulations, Rahul, on this remarkable achievement!

Happy Birthday

Tandem bike- Added a new dimension to my Cycling

Myself, Dr Manish Agrawal. I am a 43-year-old doctor, who has been into cycling for the past 6 years. I regularly bicycle 700-800 km a month. I love all kinds of cycling, Mountain biking, Road cycling, and cycling on climbs as well as flats.

I already own three primary types of bicycles: A mountain bike, a road bike and a gravel bike. Recently I added one more dimension to my cycling by purchasing a Polygon impression Tandem bike. And believe me, it was an altogether a different experience of pedaling. I would like to share some of my experiences with this bike in last one month.

I have already completed around 300 km on this bike in one month, with different partners, starting from my 9-year-old daughter to my 13-year-old son, my wife (non-cyclist) and few of the regular cyclists from our club. On one hand, a tandem gave me an opportunity to take my non-cyclist family members on my routine cycling routes, which otherwise wouldn’t have been possible, thereby introducing them to my world of cycling. And on the other hand, pedaling with some of the seasoned cyclists of club made me ride faster than on any other bike, as it combined the power of two!!

In a short span, this bicycle taught me many lessons about companionship, team spirit, mutual respect for fellow athlete, and the value of family bonding. I wish the passion for cycling stays alive within me forever.

Popular Routes of Group Ride!

Ride to Dheekli: Embark on an exciting cycling adventure to Dheekli and discover the hidden gems of the area. This cycling route takes you to the stunning Dhinkli gada lake and Panther trail, where you can enjoy scenic views and connect with nature. But the real highlight of this ride is the discovery of a new trail that leads to a hidden temple of Kundeshwar Mahadev, nestled deep within the forests of Amberi.

Ride to Nandeshwar Lake: Cycling adventure that takes you off the beaten path and immerses you in nature. Look no further than the ride to Nandeshwar lake and the beautiful trail connecting Chokadiya and Nai. Start your ride at Nandeshwar lake, a tranquil oasis that’s perfect for a refreshing break. Then, pedal your way through a beautiful trail that leads from Chokadiya to Nai. Along the way, you’ll enjoy scenic views and a chance to explore the beauty of the region.

Ride to Sendariya KherPhala and Beeda: Looking for a cycling adventure that takes you off the beaten path? Look no further than the ride to Sendariya KherPhala and Beeda. This picturesque route leads you to some of the most stunning and secluded locations in Udaipur. Start your journey at Kodiyat and discover the hidden beauty of Sendariya lake, a tranquil oasis that few people know about. Then, pedal your way to KherPhala and Beeda, two stunning hilly locations that are beloved by the Udaipur Cycling Club.

Ride to Northern Trails: Challenging and scenic cycling adventure, the ride to Northern trails is not to be missed. This 50 km route takes you on a journey towards the North of Udaipur, where you’ll discover two stunning trails. The first trail leads from Nathdwara highway to Indersagar Lake, situated behind the breathtaking Eklingji temple. The second trail takes you from Bappa Rawal to Lake Baghela, both of which offer stunning views and a chance to connect with nature. As you make your way back, get ready for an adventurous downhill ride through Parayo ki bhagal.

Ride to Varda: With stunning scenery and a chance to experience the beauty of nature, the ride to Varda is a perfect choice. This picturesque village is situated just 15 km from Udaipur, towards Ubeshwar, and is known for its scenic beauty and serpentine roads that wind their way through the forest. One of the highlights of this ride is the opportunity to witness an unforgettable sunrise over the village. The Udaipur Cycling Club has explored this route on two occasions this month, and it’s no wonder why – the beauty and tranquility of Varda are not to be missed. Join a group of fellow cyclists and experience the magic of this hidden gem for yourself.

UCC Milestone Achiever Award 2023: Celebrating the Achievements of our Cyclists!

Cycling is not just a sport, it’s a passion. And in Udaipur, we take this passion to the next level. Every year, we gather to celebrate the incredible achievements of our cyclists in the Udaipur Cycling Milestone Awards.
Current Top Standing:
6,000 KM Distance: Aashish Chittora
50,000 Meters Elevation: Dr Manish Agrawal
18+ Hundred: Nitesh Tak
250+ Riding Days: Dr Sharad Iyengar

Important Note:
We will be recognizing and awarding all members who achieve mentioned milestones in our club. To ensure fairness and clarity, we would like to outline the rules regarding these awards:

  • Every member who reaches the milestones will be recognized and awarded.
  • If a member achieves more than one milestone, they will be eligible for one award only, which will be the sum of all the milestones achieved.
  • The stats for the categories such as distance, elevation, etc. will be counted from the month in which you joined or renewed your membership with our club. For instance, if you joined in March, then the counting of your stats will begin from March only.

We hope that these rules help clarify any confusion regarding the awards and calculation of stats. If you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to reach out to us.
